chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The sourness of this world is the sweetness of the next world, and the sweetness of this world is the sourness of the next one.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between worldly hardship and afterlife reward according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates the Shia concept of *al-bala'* (trial) as a transformative mechanism where temporary worldly asceticism or hardship purifies the soul for eternal bliss. This dialectic of bitterness and sweetness reflects the theological principle that the hereafter is the true abode of reality, while this world is merely a transient field of cultivation, a view deeply rooted in the tradition of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding the value of patience (*sabr*) in the face of worldly trials.
